items.mapping_rationale: Basic affine sin/cos/sec² integration directly assesses M2T5O01D02. A tan² integral additionally demands choosing tan²=sec²−1;merely recognising1/cos²as sec² does not create a new power-reduction family. Actual polynomial/rational power terms are directly assessed when included in the requested primitive. The unassigned half-angle teaching panels teach identity choice/square reduction but are not extra questions.
